# D3VONN.IO

D3VONN.IO is an AI Business Operating System for supervised agent execution, workflow automation, persistent knowledge, governed operations, and command-center visibility.

## Canonical AI context

- Repository-aware agents should load `MASTER_CONTEXT.md` first.
- The canonical context separates implemented `main` behavior from runtime state and draft/unmerged work.
- Operational claims require runtime evidence; repository implementation alone does not prove deployment health.
- Never expose secret values or service-role credentials in AI context.

## Product summary

D3VONN.IO turns business goals into AI-assisted execution. Hermes is the orchestration layer, specialized agents perform governed work, workflows provide repeatable execution, DKOS supplies structured knowledge/memory, and command-center surfaces provide visibility into task state, approvals, and operational telemetry.

The repository also contains the AI Films subsystem for The Sovereign Signal, including TwelveLabs/Jockey intelligence, governed ingestion from MovieFlow and Google Drive, creative canon, production-bible, generation, QA, and assembly tracks. Runtime readiness must be verified independently from code presence.

## Target users

- Founders and operators building AI-powered businesses
- Teams automating repeatable workflows
- Enterprise buyers evaluating governed AI workforce systems
- Developers and partners packaging specialized agents
- Film/creative teams using the governed AI Films production workflow
